title: work.run@2
description: A work run (#1332; design: Work runs): `deep work "<scope>"` raised its one approval, the same start.approve ask `deep start approve` raises, and its words; or `deep work pause` stopped its new starts while running turns finish. A standing run (#1335) also pauses at its breaker with one ask, resumes on your yes to it, and records a notice every 7 days of what it landed, left and spent, which needs no answer. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

ask.description: The run's approval: the start.approve ask it was raised as.

step.description: asked: the run raised its approval; paused: no new starts from here; resumed: starts again, on your yes to its breaker's ask; notice: a standing run's weekly notice.

x-closure.closed: each value is a step of a work run the design names
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

scope.description: The words the run was asked in.

breaker.description: The ask a standing run's breaker paused it with, which its resume answers.

why.description: Why the breaker paused the run.

from.description: A notice's week: its start, in ms since the epoch.

to.description: A notice's week: its end, in ms since the epoch.

landed.description: The issues whose change the run landed in the week.

left.description: The issues that joined the run and haven't landed.

attempts.description: The attempts the run started in the week.

spent.description: What the run spent in the week.
